monday.name: Shiva
monday.visual_description: Ash-smeared Shiva with a crescent in his matted hair, rudraksha beads and a raised trident, seated beside white Nandi in blue-grey temple light.

monday.name: Parvati
monday.visual_description: Serene Gauri in a vermilion silk sari, with a lotus and a raised blessing palm, seated beside Shiva amid cream jasmine and warm gold lamps.

tuesday.name: Hanuman
tuesday.visual_description: Vermilion Hanuman murti with folded palms, a golden gada set beside his feet, and orange marigolds against dark stone in a Prabhadevi shrine.

tuesday.name: Kartikeya
tuesday.visual_description: Youthful Murugan holding a tall silver vel, with a regal peacock beside him and red hibiscus against gold pillars in a Tamil temple alcove.

tuesday.name: Mangala
tuesday.visual_description: A copper-toned Mangala image in red garments with a mace and ram in the carving, framed by crimson flowers and low brass lamplight.

wednesday.name: Ganesha
wednesday.visual_description: Elephant-headed Ganapati seated with one broken tusk, a bowl of modaks and a small mouse below his pedestal, lit by gold and vermilion lamplight.

wednesday.name: Krishna
wednesday.visual_description: Blue Krishna in saffron-yellow silk holds a flute to his lips, peacock feather tilted above his crown, framed by white jasmine garlands and emerald textiles.

wednesday.name: Vitthal
wednesday.visual_description: A dark stone Vitthal stands on a brick with hands on hips, a tall crown and tulsi garlands bright against a deep indigo backdrop.

thursday.name: Vishnu
thursday.visual_description: Four-armed Vishnu in yellow silk holds a conch, discus, mace and lotus, with Garuda kneeling below a carved arch in emerald and gold.

thursday.name: Sai Baba of Shirdi
thursday.visual_description: A serene white marble Sai Baba in a headcloth and long kafni, right leg crossed over the left, with roses glowing in amber aarti light.

thursday.name: Dattatreya
thursday.visual_description: Three-faced Dattatreya stands beneath a broad fig tree with a rosary and water pot, a white cow and four dogs gathered in muted ochre light.

thursday.name: Brihaspati
thursday.visual_description: The sage Brihaspati wears yellow robes and holds prayer beads and a water pot, seated on a low carved pedestal in honey-coloured lamplight.

friday.name: Lakshmi
friday.visual_description: Four-armed Lakshmi in a crimson sari sits on a pink lotus with lotuses in her upper hands, framed by gold lamps and soft ivory garlands.

friday.name: Santoshi Maa
friday.visual_description: Santoshi Maa in a red sari sits on a lotus with a raised blessing hand, a trident and sword visible in a gold-framed devotional print.

saturday.name: Shani Dev
saturday.visual_description: Dark stone Shani in indigo robes, holding a staff with a crow at the pedestal, surrounded by pinpoints of flame reflected in sesame oil.

saturday.name: Hanuman
saturday.visual_description: An upright Hanuman murti with vermilion pigment and a gold gada, one hand raised in blessing as orange marigolds catch the edge of the light.

saturday.name: Kali
saturday.visual_description: A dark blue Kali murti with flowing hair, a necklace of stylized skulls and a curved ritual sword, framed by hibiscus and deep red fabric.

sunday.name: Surya Dev
sunday.visual_description: A radiant Surya with lotuses in both hands rides a chariot drawn by seven horses, rings of copper and saffron spreading across the dawn sky.

sunday.name: Rama
sunday.visual_description: Crowned Rama holds a long bow beside Sita and Lakshmana, with Hanuman kneeling at their feet and amber lamps reflected in jade and saffron fabric.
